data.value:
A digital archive integrity and monitoring application designed to preserve the reliability of long-term file collections.
Archive Auditor creates permanent historical snapshots, calculates SHA-256 checksums, detects additions, deletions and modifications, and tracks archive growth over time.
Its purpose is simple: help ensure that your digital memories and documents remain intact, identifiable and verifiable over the years. V1.3
